content: Monochrome B&W menu bar UI pitfalls: (1) template images (isTemplate=true) auto-adapt to menu bar light/dark - custom PNGs without template rendering break monochrome in dark mode; (2) 1-2px vertical markers need sufficient contrast against bar fill - use distinct fill patterns (stripes/opacity levels) since color is unavailable; (3) opacity-based layering in pure B&W can render identically on dark menu bar backgrounds; (4) legibility: use .secondary/.tertiary foreground styles with adequate contrast ratios, monospaced digits for stable alignment; (5) menu bar dropdown (NSStatusItem/NSHostingView) vs window style affects sizing; 220px fixed width forces truncation risk.
